title: Backpropagation-free Deep Learning for Time-Series Classification
abstract: arXiv:2610.41805v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep neural networks for time series classification (TSC) are trained almost exclusively by error backpropagation, which imposes update locking and the weight-transport problem. Backpropagation-free learning rules such as Direct Feedback Alignment (DFA), Direct Random Target Projection (DRTP), and the diffusion-inspired NoProp relax these constraints but have been evaluated almost exclusively on 2D image benchmarks. We adapt these three learners to univariate TSC with 1D convolutional architectures and present the first systematic study of them across 112 datasets from the UCR time series archive, with one hyperparameter-optimized configuration per method. The optimized learners reach mean F1 scores of 0.76 to 0.79, below ROCKET (0.83) and InceptionTime (0.84). We propose an analysis framework that relates the per-dataset gap to InceptionTime to dataset properties and tests convolutional feature learning by replacing the flatten readout

translated_title: 面向时间序列分类的无反向传播深度学习
translated_abstract: 用于时间序列分类（TSC）的深度神经网络几乎完全依赖误差反向传播进行训练，而这带来了更新锁定和权重传输问题。诸如直接反馈对齐（DFA）、直接随机目标投影（DRTP）以及受扩散启发的NoProp等无反向传播学习规则放宽了这些约束，但此前几乎只在二维图像基准上被评估过。我们将这三种学习方法适配到采用一维卷积架构的单变量时间序列分类任务中，并首次在来自UCR时间序列档案的112个数据集上对它们进行了系统研究，每种方法均采用一个经超参数优化的配置。经过优化的学习器达到了0.76至0.79的平均F1分数，低于ROCKET（0.83）和InceptionTime（0.84）。我们提出了一个分析框架，将各数据集上与InceptionTime的性能差距与数据集属性相关联，并通过替换扁平化读出层来检验卷积特征学习的效果。
tldr: 本文首次将DFA、DRTP和NoProp三种无反向传播学习方法系统地应用于时间序列分类，在UCR档案的112个数据集上评估了一维卷积架构，取得0.76至0.79的平均F1分数，并提出了将性能差距与数据集属性相关联的分析框架。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic study of backpropagation-free learning rules (DFA, DRTP, and NoProp) for time-series classification using 1D convolutional architectures across 112 UCR datasets, achieving mean F1 scores of 0.76 to 0.79, and proposes an analysis framework that relates the performance gap to dataset properties.
